sections.heading: Before or After Your Delivery Order

blocks.html: Belleville sits at a sweet spot in northern Essex County, where an urban-suburban character, a rich cultural mix, and easy access to some of New Jersey's most beloved green spaces come together in one distinctly vibrant township. There's plenty to explore here, and Lady L’s cannabis delivery Belleville residents love makes it easy to enjoy it all on your own terms.

blocks.title: Branch Brook Park
blocks.html: The nation's first county park, Branch Brook spans 360 Olmsted-designed acres straddling Newark and Belleville. It holds the largest collection of cherry blossom trees in the United States, more than Washington D.C., and draws visitors from across the region every spring. The park also features a roller rink, urban farm, greenhouse, public art installations, jogging loop, and an annual Cherry Blossom Festival.

blocks.title: Solar Do Minho
blocks.html: A Belleville institution, Solar Do Minho delivers an authentic Portuguese dining experience built around fine cuisine, warm ambiance, and impeccable service. The Rodizio, a slow-roasted rotisserie experience carved tableside, is a signature draw, and the house-made sangria has earned a devoted following of its own.

blocks.title: Warique
blocks.html: Tucked away on a quiet residential corner, Warique is a small, intimate Peruvian restaurant from Belleville native Chef Roberto Carnero. With roughly 30 seats, an open kitchen, and a menu rooted in authentic Peruvian flavors and family tradition, it's the kind of neighborhood hidden gem that earns fierce loyalty from everyone who discovers it.

blocks.title: Belleville Park
blocks.html: A 32.70-acre extension of Branch Brook Park, Belleville Park runs along the Second River and offers a quieter, more neighborhood-scaled outdoor experience. Cherry blossom trees, bocce courts, softball and soccer fields, and a quarter-mile jogging path make it a well-rounded local green space worth knowing about.

blocks.title: Hendricks Field Golf Course
blocks.html: Designed by Charles Banks and opened in 1929, Hendricks Field is his only course built for public use and one of the most distinctive municipal courses in New Jersey. Situated in the heart of Belleville amid cherry trees and majestic oaks, it features classic template holes, including an Alps, a redan, a Biarritz, and the standout Principal's Nose at hole 15.

blocks.title: LaMesa Bakery
blocks.html: LaMesa Bakery specializes in custom, made-to-order buttercream cakes and desserts crafted for any occasion. Known for inventive flavor combinations like dulce de leche and espresso, banana and coconut, and carrot cake with citrus cream cheese frosting, every creation is as visually striking as it is delicious.

items.q: What's the minimum age for cannabis delivery in Belleville?
items.a_html: You must be 21 or older to place a delivery order with Lady L. New Jersey's adult-use cannabis rules apply to every transaction, without exception. Age verification happens during account setup, and your driver will confirm your ID again at the door before completing the handoff.

items.q: What kind of ID is required for a Lady L delivery order?
items.a_html: We accept any valid, government-issued photo ID. Driver's licenses, state-issued IDs, and passports all qualify, and out-of-state IDs are welcome. Your ID will need to be uploaded to your Lady L account before you place your first order and the physical ID presented when your driver arrives.

items.q: Is a medical cannabis card required for Belleville weed delivery?
items.a_html: Not at all. Lady L is an adult-use dispensary, which means any customer 21 or older is welcome to place a delivery order. A confirmed Lady L account and a valid ID are the only things you need to get started.

items.q: How much cannabis can be included in a single Belleville delivery?
items.a_html:
New Jersey law permits us to sell up to the equivalent of 28.35 grams, or one ounce, of usable cannabis per transaction. That total can include any combination of the following:

  • Dried Flower/Bud: 28.35 grams (1 ounce).
  • Concentrates/Resin/Oils: 4 grams (solid or liquid/vaporized oil).
  • Ingestible Items (Gummies/Edibles): 1,000 mg of THC (roughly ten 100mg packages).
  • Maximum Possession Limit: Up to 6 ounces of cannabis and cannabis products.
  • Mixing Products: You can mix and match, for example, by purchasing 1/2 ounce of flower and 2 grams of concentrates.
  • Daily Limits: The 1-ounce limit is generally considered a daily limit across all dispensaries.

items.q: What taxes will I see on a cannabis delivery order in Belleville?
items.a_html: New Jersey adult-use cannabis purchases include a 6.625% state sales tax, a 2% municipal transfer or user tax where applicable, and a $2.50-per-ounce Social Equity Excise Fee (SEEF). These taxes apply to Belleville weed delivery orders exactly as they do to in-store purchases, and all applicable charges are itemized at checkout before you confirm.
